task.description: Implement ISS-203: deterministic idempotency keys for engine-emitted events. Branch: feature/WF02-iss203-idempotency-keys-20260611. Follow src/design/iss203_idempotency_keys.md exactly. Touchpoints: src/engine/transition.zig (compute key per emitted event before return), src/event_store/store.zig (ON CONFLICT idempotency_key DO NOTHING on INSERT). Formula: stable_hash(instance_id ++ triggering_event_seq ++ node_id ++ emitted_event_type ++ ordinal). Constraints: transition.zig stays I/O-free (pure hashing OK); client trigger keys unchanged; duplicate insert silently ignored (not error); replay same inputs = same keys. Run: zig build, zig build test, zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set' (must be empty). Commit to feature branch before completing handoff.
acceptance_criteria: idempotency_key field added to emitted events in transition.zig output
Key = stable_hash(instance_id, triggering_event_seq, node_id, emitted_event_type, ordinal)
Re-running same transition twice produces identical keys
